metadata.description: Marketplace for the SFU TXT-to-DOCX converter skill. Installs an agent skill that generates Siberian Federal University (СФУ) academic reports in V2 TXT syntax, lints them, and converts to DOCX.

plugins.name: sfu-converter
plugins.description: Multi-skill pack for generating SFU-compliant academic documents (lab/coursework/VKR/research/practice/small-works) in V2 TXT syntax and converting them to DOCX via the sfu-converter CLI. Includes a shared sfu-common skill plus one skill per document type.
